title: GEMglClearIndex
description: specify the clear value for the color index buffers

messages.description: index used when the color index buffers are cleared

arguments.description: index used when the color index buffers are cleared

body: [GEMglClearIndex] calls glClearIndex() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glClearIndex in the OpenGL reference.
